resources.string: Advanced: each layout\'s scale, position, visible area and density, to experiment with.
With Android Auto connected and the map on the cluster, every change shows at once. Each layout keeps its own values, and the layout chosen here is the one the cluster shows.
The tuning applies with Horizon installed. The values are kept until then.
Scaling is always even: stretching one way only would distort the map.
Visible width × height: %1$d × %2$d px of the phone picture. How much of it shows; this is what keeps the route cards out.
Applies from the phone\'s next connection. Lower: more map, with a smaller arrow, streets and cards; higher: the opposite. After a change, adjust the cut again.
The three layouts and the density go back to the values measured on the car.
